title: aquarius major
intro: Aquarius major, commonly known as Indian squill, is a plant species belonging to the Amaryllidaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Aquarius major are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which may contribute to its analgesic, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including snake bites, skin conditions, and wounds.
